kind: Ethereal causal post-contact reaction study; not a trade or profitability backtest

configuration.timing: same-index snapshot known at contact candle open; contact candle cannot create its own tested zone
configuration.reference: contact candle close; observation begins with the following candle
configuration.deduplication: first overlap per stable resting-zone key across all available visible history, plus transported touchedAt evidence; no daily reset
configuration.repeatedContacts: separate completed-minute approach candidates, not independent trades or tick-resolved visits
configuration.contactInvalidationPolicy: retain causal reaction event and flag unsequenced on-contact invalidation; no assumed fill or trading success
configuration.benchmarkMeaning: symmetric descriptive reaction benchmark, not approved entry/SL/TP
configuration.benchmarkOrdering: observed open at/beyond a boundary precedes intrabar extremes; two-boundary candles opening strictly inside remain ambiguous
configuration.yellowGrade: grade known at contact; never upgrade past green events with future information
